entries.2f2097af01da6369: This is a product group of liquid seasonings such as sauces for grilled meat and soup bases for nabe (hot pot) dishes. For retail, the main products are "Hiden Yakiniku no Tare" (secret-recipe grilled meat sauce), the "Yakiniku Dori" series, nabe soup bases supervised by popular YouTubers and famous restaurants, and "Hakata Motsu-nabe Soup"; for business use, it offers oil sauces for meat processors and sauces for prepared foods. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥20,878 million.
entries.4bac38812e3a356c: These are powdered seasoning product groups centered on the Aji/Shio-Kosho series. Retail sales of the Aji/Shio-Kosho series have performed well, and for business use it sells spices, mainly for meat products. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥4,352 million.

entries.8c22a3424372950a: This is a seasoning manufacturer headquartered in Sumida-ku, Tokyo and in Higashi-ku, Fukuoka City. It is a single-segment company engaged solely in the food business, whose main products are liquid seasonings such as sauces for grilled meat and soup bases, and seasoned salt, and it has no affiliated companies. Number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 691. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
